record_type_quote: We tested the cross-cultural validity of Ganel and Goodale’s findings by collecting data from Japanese and Swedish participants.

targets.title: The effects of smiling on perceived age defy belief
targets.evidence_quote: Therefore, present study is conducted as a registered replication report to confirm the findings of Ganel and Goodale in Japan and Sweden.
targets.outcome_quote: Our results showed that we successfully replicated Ganel and Goodale (2018) in a cross-cultural context.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall verdict of successful cross-cultural replication controls. The separate prediction about stimulus culture was an extension. Supplementary original-data reanalyses do not change the primary new-sample record type.

reasoning: Title, DOI and seven authors match. New samples test Experiment 2 of the cited published paper; one original paper. Completed registered report.
